name: EK-moveGo

source.readFrom: Extracted from the Desktop design frame.

character: Clean, trustworthy CORPORATE / app-launch landing (ride-hailing app). Light, navy-blue primary, Inter, white cards with soft shadows and blue icon chips, a stat bar, a numbered step process, and a dark footer. Professional and reassuring. Best for apps, startups, services, logistics, healthcare, finance — anything that needs to look established and safe.

color.notes: Navy ink on white / very-light-blue surfaces, one navy-blue primary for CTAs, icon chips, step numbers and links. Dark navy footer. REUSE the light + one-navy-accent structure; swap navy for the lead's brand colour.

spacing.notes: Comfortable ~64–80px sections, white cards with soft shadow, ~1200px column.

button.shape: Rounded rect, solid blue primary; a white/ghost secondary.
button.notes: Primary CTA repeated at key points (hero, steps, forms).

card.shape: White, soft shadow, rounded; blue icon chip at top.

form.label: Small label above field.
form.field: Rounded input, light border; solid blue submit button.

order.layout: Logo left, nav center, blue 'Download App'/CTA right.
Light gradient. Left: a small badge, big heading (one word blue) + subhead + blue CTA. Right: product visuals (phone mockups + a real photo) floating.
A row of 4 stats separated by thin dividers (number + caption).
Centered heading + subhead, then a 3+2 grid of white feature cards (blue icon chip → title → description).
Centered heading, a 3-step horizontal process (numbered blue circles joined by a dashed line, title + text each) + a CTA button.
Two white cards side by side: a newsletter/notify signup and a partner/contact form.
A full-width photo band with dark overlay: heading + subhead + white button.
Dark navy footer: logo + address + social, multi-column links, app-store badges, language selector.

reusableArchetypes: light hero with floating product visuals + one blue word
3+2 white feature-card grid with icon chips
photo CTA band with dark overlay
dark multi-column footer with app badges
craftNotes: One navy accent + neutral greys keeps it calm and credible.
White cards with soft shadows (not hard borders); blue icon chips unify the feature grid.
Stat bar and numbered steps do the 'trust + how it works' job simply.

reuse: Great default for professional service / app / startup leads that need to look established. Take the light + one-navy-accent palette, icon-chip feature cards, stat bar, numbered steps, dual forms and dark footer. Swap navy for the lead's brand colour.
